anti_overlap: Pillar rubric validity — covered by fd-eval-measurement-validity
decision_lens: Any implementation letting one family's preferences dominate the aggregate defeats the purpose and reintroduces the bias.
focus: Whether cross-family judge implementation correctly isolates evaluator bias and prevents single family domination
name: fd-judge-family-bias-control
persona: A researcher who studies LLM self-evaluation bias and cross-model agreement patterns.
review_areas: Verify aggregation is family-weighted (one vote per family) not model-weighted (one vote per model)
Check fallback when judge family unavailable does not collapse to single-family evaluation
Verify evaluator matrix fingerprint includes full judge model IDs in stable sort order
Check REASONING_MODELS treatment — reasoning models may have systematic scoring offsets
Verify human-editor calibration scored by ALL judge families, not just primary
Check per-family score variance is computed and logged to detect substantial family bias
success_hints: Within-family judge correlation should be > 0.7; cross-family < 0.7
Swapping primary judge family should change system ranking by at most one position
task_context: cipher_evaluator_matrix.py runs N×M matrix. DEFAULT_EVALUATORS includes Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi families. Multi-family pool requires careful aggregation.
